# Version 4.157.0
> **Skia m157 rendering corrections** · Released November 17, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.157.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.157.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.157.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.157.0 brings Skia m157 with image-filter, glyph and GPU rendering fixes. The release improves filtered-image boundaries, transformed geometry and text rendering, and makes LibraryImport calling conventions explicit. Graphite Metal's native iOS and tvOS minimum rises to 15; higher managed or framework requirements still apply.

## Breaking Changes

- **Check Graphite Metal deployment requirements** — Graphite Metal now requires iOS or tvOS 15 at the native engine level; its macOS minimum remains 12. Raise deployment requirements for applications using this backend where necessary, and continue to satisfy any higher managed or framework minimums. This is not a new minimum for every SkiaSharp backend. ([#5542](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5542))

## Engine

- **Updated to Skia m157** — Moves the bundled renderer to milestone 157. HarfBuzzSharp's package revision moves to 14.4.0.200 for this milestone; the bundled native HarfBuzz engine remains 14.4.0. ([#5542](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5542))

## Bug Fixes

- **More reliable filtered-image sampling** — Keeps antialiased and MSAA image draws within their intended subsets under minification or skew, and aligns image-filter cache equality with hashing. Displacement offsets now use fp32 arithmetic to match filter bounds rather than rounding at fp16 precision. ([#5770](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5770), [#5710](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5710))
- **Corrected path and transformed geometry rendering** — Fixes convex antialiased path bounds and a heap overflow across vertical clip gaps, clamps software coverage masks, and corrects reflected zero-length hairline square caps. Transformed ellipses and rounded rectangles use corrected radii and stroke-width mapping, with corner radii constrained to the transformed bounds. ([#5612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5612), [#5630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5630), [#5670](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5670), [#5688](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5688))
- **More robust glyph rendering and replay** — Handles regenerated glyph outlines and incompatible mask formats, and preserves clipped embossed-mask planes. Direct-mask Slug replay gains validation for unsupported data, while Ganesh rounds text-atlas indices to avoid selecting the wrong texture. ([#5748](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5748), [#5612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5612), [#5630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5630), [#5670](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5670))
- **GPU clipping and submission corrections** — Fixes Graphite clip keys, wedge inflation and readback stride, and Ganesh atlas state after empty flushes. Oversized Graphite clip-stack draws are skipped with a warning instead of exceeding pass capacity. Vulkan fixes cover initialization, affected ARM driver cleanup and native synchronous wait failures; managed GRContext.Submit remains void. ([#5612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5612), [#5630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5630), [#5670](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5670), [#5688](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5688), [#5710](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5710))
- **Explicit cdecl for LibraryImport bindings** — Generated LibraryImport declarations now select cdecl explicitly, matching the existing DllImport and delegate paths. This corrects an ABI mismatch risk on Windows x86 without changing public APIs or native exports. ([#5565](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5565))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.200

HarfBuzzSharp's generated LibraryImport declarations now explicitly use cdecl, matching its DllImport and delegate paths. This corrects an ABI mismatch risk on Windows x86 without changing the public API.

## Release Candidate 2 (November 13, 2026)

Release Candidate 2 corrects transformed ellipses and rounded rectangles, Ganesh atlas state and Graphite clip capacity handling. It also improves displacement-filter precision and native synchronous Vulkan wait handling without adding a managed submission result.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6...v4.157.0-rc.2.26563.19)

## Release Candidate 1 (November 9, 2026)

Release Candidate 1 corrects reflected hairline square caps and text-atlas selection. It also delays device-loss cleanup on affected ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1...v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6)

## Preview 1 (November 6, 2026)

Preview 1 introduces Skia m157 with rasterization, glyph-replay and Graphite readback fixes, plus explicit cdecl LibraryImport bindings. Graphite Metal requires iOS or tvOS 15 at the native level; higher managed or framework requirements still apply.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.156.2...v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1)
